messages:
Samir Patel: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing an "anchor_contract" land in rollout metadata to express soft vs hard binding + a grace/epoch window for background migration.
Elena Gomez: Can you sketch the fields? I want to see how it plays with the existing "pin" semantics and rollback flow.
Samir Patel: Minimal concept sketch: 
```
anchor_contract: {
  type: "soft" | "hard",
  grace_window_seconds: 86400,       # duration before automated migration takes effect
  stabilization_epoch: 3,            # number of successful deploys before we consider it stable
  fallback_priority: ["v1", "v0"],
  compatibility_tags: ["kv-cache-v2", "quant-8bit"]
}
```
Samir Patel: Soft anchor = route to pinned version but allow controller to auto-migrate after grace_window if canary checks pass. Hard anchor = strict no-auto-migrate unless manual override.
Priya Rao: stabilization_epoch is good. Who does the pin move after grace window — infra service or rollout controller?
Jamal Carter: Controller should, but only after passing the configured canary/eval checks. Also we need a handoff event so audit shows when soft -> hard happened.
Kai Chen: Add oscillation protection: on regression double the grace_window (decay/backoff), cap at 7d. prevents flip-flopping.
Elena Gomez: Backcompat: if anchor_contract absent, treat as {type: "soft", grace_window_seconds:0, stabilization_epoch:0} to preserve current behavior.
Samir Patel: Agreed — default no-op. Also allow scoped anchors:
```
anchor_contracts: [
  {scope: "embeddings", type: "hard"},
  {scope: "chat", type: "soft", grace_window_seconds: 43200}
]
```
Priya Rao: Scoped anchors help customers who need embeddings strictly pinned but want chat to evolve.
Jamal Carter: Add migration_confidence_metric so controller knows which eval to query, e.g. "perplexity_delta@1000".
Samir Patel: Good — controller will fetch eval infra. Also event types: anchor.grace.start, anchor.grace.end, anchor.hardened, anchor.rolled_back. Controller should emit anchor.grace.start when timer begins and anchor.grace.end with outcome.
Elena Gomez: Reuse existing rollout.{phase}.{outcome} event pattern to stay consistent with current schema.
Priya Rao: Security: some customers require hard anchors via compliance. We need ACL so only org-admins can flip soft->hard for certain namespaces.
Jamal Carter: Implementation plan:
 - schema PR with validation + sensible defaults
 - controller: grace timer + canary evaluator hook + backoff logic
 - audit/events plumbing and metrics
 - console: visualize anchor states + admin-only harden/rollback buttons
Samir Patel: Timeline: schema PR this week; controller spike next sprint. I'll draft the schema and add unit tests for defaulting behavior.
Kai Chen: I'll add decay/backoff to the controller spike and write a small simulator to test oscillation cases.
Priya Rao: I'll mock console UI and ACL flows.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: schema-validation-service -> staging at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z
Samir Patel: Noted :thumbsup:
